human_labels.judge_rationale: The artifact correctly invalidates the contaminated result and prescribes targeted, work-preserving cleanup, a fresh runner, and a separate judge. It falls short of the exact recovery bar because it omits giving the rerun runner the skill instructions and does not explicitly make the isolated workspace a throwaway sandbox without writable live-checkout access.

observations.value:
The run is invalid. Seeing the case bar compromised blindness, so neither its artifact nor grade can count.

Recovery:

1. Discard the contaminated artifact and all results derived from it.
2. Compare the live checkout with its pre-run state using status/diffs.
3. Identify only files and hunks created or changed by the runner.
4. Revert those specific tracked-file hunks and delete only runner-created untracked files. Do not use broad cleanup, reset, checkout, or clean commands.
5. Preserve all unrelated existing work. If ownership of any change is ambiguous, stop and ask before modifying it.
6. Confirm the checkout contains no remaining runner leaks.
7. Rerun the case with a fresh, context-free agent in an isolated workspace. Give the runner only the case input—no bar, expected outcome, prior artifact, or conversation context.
8. After the run, sweep the live checkout again and remove any leaks with the same targeted procedure.
9. Have a separate judge evaluate the new artifact using the bar and the skill’s first principles.
10. Count only this clean rerun in the evaluation report.
